svg.title: Different Graphs with One Spectral Projection
svg.desc: The graphs at r=−4 and r=−2 share diagonal (10,4,4) and the same nearest point in the spectral cone. The first has spanning-tree coefficient 24, Kirchhoff index 10/3, R13=1/6, R24=1; the second has 36, 23/9, R13=1/5, R24=26/45. The right panel shows the verified functions R13=(2/5)(26+4r)/(40−r²) and R24=(2/5)(44−4r)/(40−r²) on [−4,−2/3].

cc:Work.dc:description: The graphs at r=−4 and r=−2 share diagonal (10,4,4) and the same nearest point in the spectral cone. The first has spanning-tree coefficient 24, Kirchhoff index 10/3, R13=1/6, R24=1; the second has 36, 23/9, R13=1/5, R24=26/45. The right panel shows the verified functions R13=(2/5)(26+4r)/(40−r²) and R24=(2/5)(44−4r)/(40−r²) on [−4,−2/3].
